battleFormations.name: Data-Psalm Conclave
battleFormations.effect: Benedictions of the Omnissiah: Select for the whole battle: Panegyric Procession (+1 AP at half range) or Citation in Savagery (+1 Strength/Attacks in melee after charging).

battleFormations.name: Explorator Maniple
battleFormations.effect: Acquisition At Any Cost: Select an 'Acquisition' objective marker each Command phase; re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for attacks made near it.

battleFormations.name: Skitarii Hunter Cohort
battleFormations.effect: Stealth Optimisation: SKITARII INFANTRY/MOUNTED and IRONSTRIDER BALLISTARII units gain the Stealth ability.

battleFormations.name: Cohort Cybernetica
battleFormations.effect: Cyber-Psalm Programming: Non-Battle-shocked LEGIO CYBERNETICA units get +2" Move and +1 OC.

battleFormations.name: Rad-Zone Corps
battleFormations.effect: Rad-bombardment: Round 1, bombard enemy units in their deployment zone for mortal wounds/Battle-shock. Rounds 2-5, Fallout ability: on a 3+ per enemy unit in their deployment zone, inflict 1 mortal wound and a Battle-shock test.

artefacts.name: Radial Suffusion
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only] Extends the Fallout ability's range to 6" beyond the enemy deployment zone.

artefacts.name: Malphonic Susurrus
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only] The bearer's led unit gains the Stealth ability.

artefacts.name: Peerless Eradicator
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only] Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer's led unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

artefacts.name: Autoclavic Denunciation
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS MECHANICUS only] Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+].

artefacts.name: Cantic Thrallnet
artefacts.effect: [SKITARII MARSHAL only] Grants both Doctrina Imperatives to one unit for a round.

artefacts.name: Clandestine Infiltrator
artefacts.effect: [SKITARII only] The bearer's unit gains Infiltrators and Scouts 6".

artefacts.name: Veiled Hunter
artefacts.effect: [SKITARII MARSHAL only] Redeploy up to 3 Infantry units, any of which can instead be placed into Reserves.

artefacts.name: Battle-sphere Uplink
artefacts.effect: [SKITARII only] The bearer's unit can move after shooting (loses charge eligibility that turn).

artefacts.name: Mechanicus Locum
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] The bearer has a Leadership characteristic of 6+ and can clear Battle-shock once per battle.

artefacts.name: Mantle of the Gnosticarch
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Damage against the bearer is capped to 1.

artefacts.name: Data-blessed Autosermon
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Once per battle, activate the other Benediction ability for the bearer's own unit.

artefacts.name: Temporcopia
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] The bearer's unit gains the Fights First ability.

artefacts.name: Magos
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] On a 4+, near the Acquisition marker, for 1CP.

artefacts.name: Genetor
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] The bearer's led unit has a 4+ invulnerable save near the Acquisition marker.

artefacts.name: Logis
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Add 1 to Hit rolls against targets near the Acquisition marker.

artefacts.name: Artisan
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Once per phase, set a roll to an unmodified 6 near the Acquisition marker.

artefacts.name: Necromechanic
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Once per round, negate a failed save (Damage 0) for a nearby Vehicle/Cybernetica unit.

artefacts.name: Lord of Machines
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Debuff or disable an enemy Vehicle's shooting once per turn.

artefacts.name: Emotionless Clarity
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] Auto-inflict Deadly Demise mortal wounds instead of rolling.

artefacts.name: Arch-negator
artefacts.effect: [TECH-PRIEST only] The bearer's ranged weapons gain [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+].

armyRules.name: Doctrina Imperatives
armyRules.effect: At the start of the battle round, select one: Protector Imperative (ranged weapons gain [HEAVY], +1 BS, and -1 to Hit vs melee for BATTLELINE units or units near one) or Conqueror Imperative (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT], +1 WS, and +1 AP for BATTLELINE units or units near one).
